_about: Raid flag trees per expansion. Each name is an achievement as it appears in /outputfile achievement (matching ignores case, backticks vs apostrophes, and extra spaces). A name given as a list means any of those spellings counts. 'enter' is what a raider needs to zone in (participate); 'request' is what the person requesting the raid needs. Requirements are groups: {all:[...]} or {any:[...]}, and every group must pass.

tiers.label: Tier 1

raids.ach: Conqueror of the House of Thule

ach: Partisan of the House of Thule

tiers.note: Open from the start. Tick Tock's zone-in NPC has been reported to let in only people with Hero of the House of Thule (the Welcome to My Nightmare mission).

tiers.label: Tier 2

any: Conqueror of the House of Thule

all: Conqueror of the House of Thule

tiers.note: Allakhazam: either Tier 1 raid lets you zone in; the requester needs both. Each Tier 2 raid drops Rusty Gate Keys (3, or 5 from Erudin Burning).

tiers.label: Tier 3a

raids.ach: Conqueror of the House of Thule, Upper Floors

ach: Partisan of the House of Thule, Upper Floors
Partisan of House of Thule, Upper Floors

tiers.note: Zoning in needs a looted and clicked Rusty Gate Key. These raids drop Tremulous Keys.

tiers.label: Tier 3b
tiers.note: Zoning in needs a looted and clicked Tremulous Key from any Tier 3a raid. Cazic drops Sanctum Keys.

tiers.label: Tier 3c

all: Conqueror of the House of Thule, Upper Floors
Conqueror of the House of Thule, Upper Floors

tiers.note: No key: Allakhazam says all three Tier 3a raids plus Cazic. Rasper's Realm says killing Cazic flags the whole raid. The Progression achievement for Morell's raid access is earned from these same 4 kills. The Awakening drops Sanctum Keys.

tiers.label: Tier 4

raids.raid: Sanctum Somnium (7 events: Taking the Tower, The Essence of Dreams, Under the Sea, Isles of Sand, Elements of a Dream, The Cages of Testing, Morell Ascendant)

tiers.note: Zoning in needs a looted and clicked Sanctum Key (from Cazic or The Awakening) plus all Tier 3 raids. Conqueror of Sanctum Somnium needs all 7 events.

HoT.progression_note: Names follow the in-game style for split achievements ("(Group)" / "(Raid)"). The bare name and the reference list's "Castel" spelling also count. Check them against a fully flagged export.
HoT.eighty_five: Anyone missing the zone-in flag can still be brought in when at least 85% of the force has it.
